title: Book Three · Chapter 174: The Letter Says Received
story:
Two weeks after Ronan posts his application, a letter from the coastal centre arrives.

The autumn term has begun. It is his final term at the local school, and his books are open on the table when Mum brings the envelope.

He sees the centre's address and puts his pencil down.

“News?” Mum asks.

“I need to read it.”

He opens the letter carefully. The first line says the application has arrived. All three parts are there.

Ronan reads the line again, then smiles.

“It got there.”

Mum sits near the table while he reads the rest.

The staff will review the application during winter. Decisions will go out in the spring. There is no offer of a place in this letter.

One line asks for an updated teacher's note after his final school term. The first note is accepted with the packet. The final update can follow when the term ends.

Ronan puts a small mark beside that request.

At school the next day, he shows it to his teacher. She reads the line and writes a reminder in her book.

“When our term's work is complete,” she says.

Ronan nods. He puts the letter with his application copy and takes out the work for today's lesson.

At lunch, Anna asks about the reply.

“All three parts arrived,” he tells her. “They will read them in winter.”

She smiles. Her own packet has had longer to travel. She is still waiting for its receipt letter.

“The stair is probably having a rest,” Ronan says.

“It has all that paper work to recover from.”

They laugh quietly. Then Anna opens her maths book, and he moves his lunch box away from her page.

That evening, Ronan writes his twenty-third letter to Leo. He gives the exact news: the packet is received, the review is still ahead.

Then he asks about Leo's work plans. He adds the birthday game joke and a question about his friend in the other city.

Ronan posts the letter after school the following afternoon. He pays from his separate spending money. The saved study money stays at home.

On his way back, he sees two younger students stop to read the school notice board. One points to a line and asks the other a question.

Ronan keeps walking toward the gate. At home, he has his own final-term page to finish before dinner, and the centre's letter to put safely with his papers.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

received＝已收到；update＝补充最新情况；reminder＝提醒；review＝审阅、审核。

## 理解问题

1. 收件信确认了什么、尚未决定什么？最后一学期结束后还需补什么？
2. 第二十三封信是否已实际寄出？邮费来自哪部分钱？

## 读句子

**All three parts are there.**

拆开看：All three parts / are / there.

三项材料／都已经／到了中心。
